milestones.goal: J1 core and J3 work end to end on AWS: a live drill against the leaky shop finds 3 leaks and the console shows them
J1 runs in GitLab: pipeline, Duo fix flow, manual production job, release, canary
Judged path finished, verified live, recorded and submitted

tasks.title: Drill core with tests
tasks.objective: Canary generation, data map, matching, sinks and reports, covered by unit tests

tasks.title: Shop app under test (clean baseline)
tasks.objective: Signup, checkout and support routes with access lines, vendor clients and hashed passwords; no leaks

tasks.title: Gate API: vendor stubs, runs, live drill
tasks.objective: Vendor capture endpoint with key and size limit, runs API, rate-limited live drill endpoint

tasks.title: AWS bootstrap and first deploy
tasks.objective: Tables, roles, Lambda functions with URLs for shop-main, shop-leaky and gate; deploy script used by CI later
tasks.rollback: infra/aws/teardown.sh removes the functions and tables

tasks.title: Leaky merge request content
tasks.objective: Branch newsletter-optin adds a newsletter opt-in with three realistic leaks; deployed as shop-leaky
tasks.rollback: delete the branch and the leaky function
tasks.notes: Code lives on branch newsletter-optin, not on main

tasks.title: Drill CLI and first live runs
tasks.objective: CLI writes JSON, JUnit, security report and markdown, posts to the gate; live runs: leaky 3 leaks, main 0
verify: observe: live drill against shop-leaky reports 3 leaks and against shop-main reports 0

tasks.title: Console S1 per UI-SPEC
tasks.objective: Flow map, evidence list and drawer, before/after toggle, live drill with streamed steps, replay, judge card, first-run and error states
verify: observe: console at 1440 and 390 shows the leaks and Run a live drill on the first screen

tasks.title: Backup take of the working path
tasks.objective: Record the first working end-to-end path as a backup video take
verify: observe: backup take recorded from the deployed console

tasks.title: GitLab pipeline
tasks.objective: Build, package, review deploy per MR, drill with JUnit and security reports, manual production deploy, release with record of processing, OIDC to AWS
verify: observe: merge request pipeline fails on the leaky branch with findings in the merge request

tasks.title: Duo leak-fix flow and trigger
tasks.objective: Custom flow triggered by the failed pipeline reads the leak report, commits fixes, notes the MR; held destinations go to the privacy lead
verify: observe: flow session commits a fix and the rerun drill passes

tasks.title: Production canary and incident issue
tasks.objective: Scheduled pipeline runs the drill against production and opens an issue on a leak
verify: observe: scheduled pipeline ran against production

tasks.title: Repository front door
tasks.objective: MIT LICENSE, README first screen, GitHub mirror
verify: observe: LICENSE detected in the GitLab About section

tasks.title: Console polish: states, responsive, how and record pages
tasks.objective: All ?state= views, 320 to 1440, /how and /record, wordmark and favicon, a11y pass, foldcheck
verify: observe: foldcheck passes at 1440 and 390 on the deployed URL

tasks.title: Security gate and cleanup
tasks.objective: Secret scan, env review, abuse limits, dependency audit, remove scaffold leftovers
verify: observe: no secrets in history or client bundles

tasks.title: Live verification
tasks.objective: Demo flow three times on the deployed URL, desktop and phone widths, logged out
verify: observe: three clean demo runs on the live URL at 1440 and 390

tasks.title: Final take
tasks.objective: Record the final video from the frozen build
verify: observe: final video under 180 s passes the video checks

tasks.title: Submission
tasks.objective: Form text, README check, pb.py submit check
